release_body:
# Ontology of Continua Core v1.3.3

Bounded external-review scientific release with typed foundations, proof/evidence ledgers, reproducibility package, and journal owner-review packets

## Table of Contents

1. Scope and release boundary
2. Core scientific artifacts
3. Public assets and checksums
4. Journal package status
5. Zenodo DOI and citation
6. Release governance

## Scope

This is the public GitHub and Zenodo release of OC Core 1.3.3. It is a bounded external-review scientific release: the release surface promotes the model-core claims supported by the included proof, finite-model, validation, reproducibility, and adversarial-review artifacts. Broader full-science and universal modern-science-superiority obligations remain in the background research program unless explicitly evidenced in this release package.

## Public Assets

| Asset | Role | How to use it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [OC_CORE_1_3_3_MASTER_MONOGRAPH_EN.pdf](https://github.com/alexanderyashin/ontology-of-continua-core-main/releases/download/v1.3.3/OC_CORE_1_3_3_MASTER_MONOGRAPH_EN.pdf) | Master monograph | Canonical long-form scientific reference. |
| [OC_CORE_1_3_3_JOURNAL_CORE_EN.pdf](https://github.com/alexanderyashin/ontology-of-continua-core-main/releases/download/v1.3.3/OC_CORE_1_3_3_JOURNAL_CORE_EN.pdf) | Journal core article | Compact article-style entry point. |
| [OC_CORE_1_3_3_METHODS_AND_REPRODUCIBILITY_COMPANION_EN.pdf](https://github.com/alexanderyashin/ontology-of-continua-core-main/releases/download/v1.3.3/OC_CORE_1_3_3_METHODS_AND_REPRODUCIBILITY_COMPANION_EN.pdf) | Methods and reproducibility companion | Reproducibility, validation, and audit navigation. |
| [OC_CORE_1_3_3_REVIEWER_ATTACK_AND_RESPONSE_MAP_EN.pdf](https://github.com/alexanderyashin/ontology-of-continua-core-main/releases/download/v1.3.3/OC_CORE_1_3_3_REVIEWER_ATTACK_AND_RESPONSE_MAP_EN.pdf) | Reviewer attack and response map | Adversarial objections, boundaries, and responses. |
| [oc_core_1_3_3_public_release.zip](https://github.com/alexanderyashin/ontology-of-continua-core-main/releases/download/v1.3.3/oc_core_1_3_3_public_release.zip) | Public reproducibility package | Proof/evidence corpus and journal owner-review material. |
| [checksums.txt](https://github.com/alexanderyashin/ontology-of-continua-core-main/releases/download/v1.3.3/checksums.txt) | Checksums | SHA-256 integrity list for all public assets. |

Checksums for the complete public asset set are in [`checksums.txt`](https://github.com/alexanderyashin/ontology-of-continua-core-main/releases/download/v1.3.3/checksums.txt). Machine-readable metadata is provided as `manifest.json`, `CITATION.cff`, `default.codemeta.json`, and `ro-crate-metadata.jsonld`.

## Journal Packages

The eight journal packages are included as owner-review material. Journal submissions require a separate owner approval before outbound use.

## Zenodo

DOI: Pending until Zenodo publication completes

DOI link: Pending until Zenodo publication completes

Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.17899134

Previous version DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19956854

## Keywords

Ontology of Continua, OC Core, systems theory, formal methods, reproducible research, mathematical modeling, scientific release engineering, cross-domain modeling, proof governance, target-blind validation

#OntologyOfContinua #OCCore #SystemsTheory #FormalMethods #ReproducibleResearch #ScientificRelease #ProofGovernance

## Governance

GitHub Release and Zenodo publication were owner-approved for this release phase. Journal submission, email, and Software Heritage deposit are not enabled by this release action.

zenodo_html_description:
Ontology of Continua Core v1.3.3 is a bounded external-review scientific release of the Ontology of Continua core model. The release packages the typed foundation, theorem and proof ledgers, Lean/finite-model evidence, target-blind validation summaries, reproducibility material, and adversarial-review closure artifacts used for external scientific review.

The promoted release claims are bounded by the included evidence. Broader full-science completion and universal modern-science-superiority obligations remain part of the continuing research program unless explicitly evidenced in this package.

Recommended reading order

  1. Science Monolith - OC_CORE_1_3_3_MASTER_MONOGRAPH_EN.pdf
  2. Journal Core - OC_CORE_1_3_3_JOURNAL_CORE_EN.pdf
  3. Methods and Reproducibility Companion - OC_CORE_1_3_3_METHODS_AND_REPRODUCIBILITY_COMPANION_EN.pdf
  4. Reviewer Attack and Response Map - OC_CORE_1_3_3_REVIEWER_ATTACK_AND_RESPONSE_MAP_EN.pdf
  5. Public reproducibility package - proof, finite-model, validation, review, metadata, and checksum artifacts.

Release contents

  • Four substantive English PDF documents: monograph, journal core article, methods companion, and reviewer response map.
  • One public reproducibility package containing proof, validation, review, metadata, and journal owner-review materials.
  • Checksums are provided in the uploaded checksums.txt file and inside the public release package.

Citation and links

  • Version DOI: pending
  • Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.17899134
  • Zenodo record assigned during publication
  • GitHub release

Governance boundary

GitHub Release and Zenodo publication are approved for OC Core v1.3.3. Journal packages are included as owner-review material only; journal submission, email campaigns, and Software Heritage deposit require separate approval.

Keywords: Ontology of Continua, OC Core, systems theory, formal methods, reproducible research, mathematical modeling, scientific release engineering, cross-domain modeling
